description_en: Lists all custom response pages created by the user. This operation supports pagination and allows you to retrieve the response page list by specifying the page number and page size
description_zh: 列举用户已创建的所有自定义响应页面。该接口提供了分页功能，支持根据页码和页大小获取响应页面列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-pages --query-args ContentType=application/json NameDescriptionLike=example --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPages

fields.help_en: The keyword used for fuzzy matching against the name or description of custom pages
fields.help_zh: 模糊查询自定义页面的名称或者描述
fields.name: name_description_like

fields.help_en:
The Content-Type field in the HTTP header. Example values:
* text/html
* application/json
fields.help_zh:
指定HTTP Header中的Content-Type字段，例如：
* text/html
* application/json
fields.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The query parameters passed in JSON format, which contain various filter conditions
parameters.help_zh: 查询参数，以JSON格式传递，包含各种筛选条件
parameters.name: query_args

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: **1 to 100000**. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页面号码，取值范围为：**1~100000**，默认1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size
